system.description:
Nightly Rests (Passive): In order to nightly rest, a character must be Safe (nothing could attack you), Sheltered from the elements (in a tent, covered wagon, or lean-to), have Food and Water (clean water and food), and Comfort (you can rest your head comfortably: blankets, or a bedroll). Only then can you take a nightly rest.

2 Item Slots · 18gc · Travel Gear, rulebook p.206
